about.title: The History of Sirius Teaház
about.history1: The founding idea of the Sirius Club was born on December 25, 2001. After five months of intense work, it opened on June 1, 2002, and operated as a private club for half a year. This period was at least as adventurous as the 20th century in human history.
about.history2: After several smaller and larger changes, it acquired its current character by May 2003.
about.history3: The main considerations in creating the Teaház were variety, versatility, coziness, comfort, three-dimensional utilization, creative solutions, and lots of manual work.
about.history4: Our guests can choose from nearly 80 types of tea from almost every corner of the world, taste our special coffees made from Central American coffee, or enjoy other offerings. All this can be done sitting on chairs, benches, cushions, or comfortably lounging on one of the galleries.
about.history5: Children's games can be found in the play area, and adult games on the bookshelf. There are opportunities for screenings, various presentations, and we are happy to host art exhibitions as well. Furthermore, everyone can read what is written in the 1000-page great book!

tea.title: The World of Tea
tea.intro: Tea is a plant native to Asia (Camellia Sinensis), from whose leaves various teas are made. We classify teas into three main groups: black teas, oolong teas, and green teas. The difference comes from the processing method.

black.name: Black Teas
black.description: Black teas are fermented the longest. The processing process: withering (the tea loses most of its moisture content here), rolling (the tea leaves are rolled together), fermentation (the leaves are left to stand for a certain period at the appropriate temperature so that the natural chemical processes initiated by rolling can exert their effect to the necessary extent).

oolong.name: Oolong Teas
oolong.description: For oolong, or yellow tea, the process is the same as for black teas, only the fermentation time is shorter.

green.name: Green Teas
green.description: Green teas are not fermented at all. The type of tea is also determined by the harvest time of the tea and which leaf of the tea plant it is made from.

herbal.name: Herbal Teas
herbal.description: They are made from various medicinal herbs, and the preparation method can be varied. Of course, most of the teas mentioned above also have health-protective and healing effects, but their base is not medicinal herbs, but the tea plant.

fruit.name: Fruit Teas
fruit.description: They are made from infusions of various fruits.

rooibos.name: Rooibos Tea
rooibos.description: A popular, light, flavorful drink from South Africa. It is increasingly popular and sought after in Europe. The plant is native to the Cape province of South Africa, and in its natural state it can only be found here, in the microclimate of the Cadarberg mountain region. Its processing is the same as black tea. Since rooibos tea contains no caffeine and is low in tannin, it is calming and particularly recommended for irritability, headaches, sleep disorders, insomnia, and depression.
